`styles.gif` and `onboarding.gif` collect previews of all
three wallpapers. Each artwork keeps its corresponding attribution and terms in
the table above: the Autumn restriction applies to Autumn, and the Mountain
artwork adaptations remain CC BY-SA 4.0. These files do not grant a single shared
license for the different artworks.

Changes for previews: viewport scaling/cropping, interface overlays, and GIF
palette quantization. GIF loop boundaries blend into their opening frame.
No wallpaper has been repainted or generated with AI.

[How to record](../../../docs/screenshots.md).
